`games.py`, `evaluation/` and `starter/load_smart_tagging.py` are copied unchanged from
[metrica-sports/more-than-a-hack-2027](https://github.com/metrica-sports/more-than-a-hack-2027)
under the MIT Licence in `LICENSE-more-than-a-hack-2027`, so the official scorer and the frame
alignment are exactly the organisers'. That includes the public 5-minute ground truth in `evaluation/gt/`.
